# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# AttendAI — Python 3.11+ dependencies
# macOS (Apple Silicon or Intel)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
#
# INSTALL ORDER (important — dlib must come before face_recognition):
#
#   Step 1 — system deps (macOS)
#     brew install cmake
#
#   Step 2 — create a clean conda env (recommended)
#     conda create -n attendai python=3.11 -y
#     conda activate attendai
#
#   Step 3 — install all Python packages
#     pip install -r requirements.txt
#
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
